title: I made Newgrounds for AI games
author: porky11
selftext:
I made a social inspired by Newgrounds, Twitter and YouTube.

It runs in [Freenet](https://freenet.org/), and you can upload all the common types of media (images, video, audio, SVG) and HTML webpages that contain your game.

Try it [here](https://try.freenet.org/v1/contract/web/DgNG4DX1CzhHxgrkhiU3DiXfaft3SZCFGeq45oF65cRD/).

Video shows how it looks right now. So far I uploaded some of my games and some test games.

AI should be able to use it.

If you want to make your own account, I recommend to [install Freenet](https://freenet.org/quickstart/) and use [this link](http://localhost:7509/v1/contract/web/DgNG4DX1CzhHxgrkhiU3DiXfaft3SZCFGeq45oF65cRD/) instead for security reasons.

It has some inbult features like:
- records (achievements, highscore, etc.)
- a recommendation algorithm
- likes, dislikes, comments
- notifications
- AI friendly posting and upload methods
- PoW to prevent spam
- reputation based filters

Because it's built on top of Freenet, it runs without a central server. No censorship possible.

I also think about adding monetization options. Using Monero Mining seems like the most promising option to me right now.

It hasn't been tested well yet, as I'm the only user so far.
I'm excited to see how well it runs with real users.
If you have some feedback or issues, let me know.
You can also check the code or report issues on my [GitLab](https://gitlab.com/porky11/asocial).
